_comment: Commits that reached a PR branch WITHOUT a PR-TASK trailer, attributed to their epic here instead of rewriting published history (operator ruling 2026-09-30).
Read by scripts/gates/check-pr-task-trailers.ts. Each entry needs the FULL 40-hex sha, an epic id from agent/worklist/epics.jsonl, and a reason of at least 40 characters.

The gate refuses a STALE entry (sha not reachable from the tip), a REDUNDANT one (the commit carries a trailer), a duplicate, a short sha and an unknown epic. An entry for an already-merged commit is inert and may be pruned.

attributions.reason: Pins bump commit drafted by `npm run pins -- bump`, which omits the PR-TASK trailer when the branch snapshot names several epics and no --task is passed (scripts/pins/pins.ts:892); it sits between two 9f92c43e commits of the ci-green run, and the no-amend rule forbids rewriting it.
